title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Schedule of Charges at Funding
content:
Two charges arise when an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is funded: the loan fee, a percentage of the original principal held between a minimum and a maximum, and the lien filing fee, passed through for each unit pledged.

| Product | Loan fee (% of original principal) | Minimum loan fee (USD) | Maximum loan fee (USD) | Lien filing fee per unit pledged (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 0.5 | 150 | 750 | 22 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 0.5 | 200 | 1500 | 20 |
| New Equipment Loan | 0.4 | 250 | 2500 | 20 |
| Irrigation System Loan | 0.35 | 350 | 3500 | 45 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 0.3 | 500 | 5000 | 45 |

## Definitions

- **Loan fee** — the loan fee at funding, as a percentage of original principal.
- **Minimum loan fee** — the minimum loan fee, USD.
- **Maximum loan fee** — the maximum loan fee, USD.
- **Lien filing fee** — the lien perfection cost passed through per unit pledged (title lien notation for titled units, UCC or fixture filing otherwise), USD.

## Notes on the schedule

- The EquipDirect Dealer Contract carries a loan fee of 0 with both bounds at 0.
- The lien filing fee is charged per unit: a loan secured by three units carries the per-unit figure three times. Hypothetical: three units pledged to an Irrigation System Loan carry 45 USD each, 135 USD in all.
- The lien filing fee covers title lien notation for titled units (trucks, semi tractors, trailers) and a UCC or fixture filing for other units.
